question: What total revenue will Nebius Group report for Q3 2026?

calls.reasoning: Run-rate anchor: June-exit ARR $3.0B ≈ $250M/month, so a flat Q3 would be ~$750M. In the past two quarters revenue came in at 1.21-1.28x the starting run-rate, which implies ~$908-960M. Consensus ranges $905-937M (individual analysts $877-943M); Equibles forecasts $934.5M on 9-12% monthly growth. Management said late-Q2 capacity would start earning in Q3 and Microsoft tranches were delivered. Downside: Vineland delay flagged by DA Davidson, financing strain in October, Microsoft capex softness. Past surprises were about ±5% and two-sided. No human prediction market matches this question; the only nearby Polymarket contract is about an acquisition before 2027, which is irrelevant.
